## About
Menlo Atherton Auto Repair is a family-owned and operated shop on El Camino Real in Menlo Park. We look after cars for our neighbors in Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Atherton, Portola Valley and Mountain View.
The first time you visit, we enter your car's information into our computer system. That way we can plan future service more accurately and get you in and out faster. Drop your car off and we'll call you first thing in the morning to work out a service plan.
One reviewer said everybody here is super nice and made her feel welcome. Another thanked Philip and a mechanic for diagnosing and fixing his electrical problem on a Saturday so he could get back on the road.

## Services
- Hybrid Service & Repair: Hybrids need special care. Our ASE certified mechanics know how the computer system switches between electric and gas, and how the engine parts differ.
- Engine Repair and Replacement: From engine repairs to full replacement.
- Transmission service and repair: Transmission service and repair done here at the shop.
- Electrical system diagnosis and repair: We track down electrical problems and fix them. One reviewer's Jeep was diagnosed, parts delivered and repaired over a Saturday.
- Muffler service and repair: Muffler service and repair.
- Steam clean engines: We steam clean engines.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Atherton, Portola Valley and Mountain View from our shop on El Camino Real in Menlo Park.

Q: Which hybrids do you work on?
A: Hybrids we work on include the Toyota Prius, Toyota Camry Hybrid, Ford Fusion Hybrid, Ford C-Max, Honda Civic Hybrid, Hyundai Sonata Hybrid, Chevy Volt and Nissan Leaf, among others.

Q: How do appointments work?
A: Send a request through our appointment form. The date and time you ask for may not be open, so we'll contact you to confirm the actual details. Once your car is here, we'll call you first thing in the morning to set a service plan.

Q: Can I get my car's service information if I sell it?
A: Yes. We keep your car's information in our computer system, and if you ever need it to sell your car, we'll be happy to provide it.
